# Templates

Copy the relevant template, fill every field, and delete nothing. A field that
does not apply is filled with "Not applicable" and a reason, never removed.

An empty field is a question nobody asked. A removed field is a question
nobody will ever ask again.

| Template | Use when |
| --- | --- |
| `SPEC-TEMPLATE.md` | Starting a new sub project |
| `TASK-TEMPLATE.md` | Writing an implementation plan for an approved spec |
| `ADR-TEMPLATE.md` | Making a decision that is expensive to reverse |
| `CHANGE-TEMPLATE.md` | Recording a material change after a spec is approved |
| `ISSUE-TEMPLATE.md` | Recording a defect, risk or gap |
